indications:
VEPPANU is indicated for the treatment of adults with estrogen receptor (ER)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative, 
  estrogen receptor-1 (ESR1)-mutated advanced or metastatic breast cancer, as detected by an FDA-authorized test,  with disease progression following at least one line of endocrine therapy.
contraindications: Select patients for treatment with VEPPANU based on the presence of ESR1 mutation. (2.1) Recommended Dosage : 200 mg orally once daily with food. (2.2) Interruption, dose reduction, or permanent discontinuation may be required due to adverse reactions. (2.3)
